plan.summary: Lowers the export batch size from 2000 to 500 rows. The PR also removes a debug log, renames a local variable and fixes a README typo. Those three edits do not change behavior.
plan.riskRationale: One constant changes. Smaller batches change how rows are grouped for export, but the logic is not changed. The other edits are cosmetic.
plan.storyArc: The only real change is the smaller export batch size. The debug log removal, the variable rename and the typo fix are cleanup and need no explanation.

noise.reason: Local variable rename with the same behavior.

topics.title: Export batches shrink to 500 rows
topics.narrativeBrief: What does lowering BATCH_ROWS from 2000 to 500 change for exports? Verify that batches() uses BATCH_ROWS as its chunk size, and check for other users of the constant.
